metadata.environment: Windows 11 Home, AMD Ryzen 7 5700U, Python 3.14 GA

reconciliation_explanation: Mem0 SDK (infer=False) raw ingestion is faster on average (~86 ms vs ~165 ms) because it skips input guard validation, tag regex sanitization, slot tracking, and contradiction detection. Furthermore, Mesh performs in-store semantic deduplication queries on every turn: in an empty store (turns 1-50), Mesh ingests short turns in ~5-15 ms. As the store grows past 400 items, the dedupe vector scan and slot contradiction check inspect the growing memory set, increasing latency to ~165 ms per turn. This trade-off ensures high retrieval integrity and zero corrupted or conflicting memories at the cost of deliberate local pipeline checks.
